questions.question: Identify the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: 'If only I [think] that way, we might have avoided this misunderstanding.'
options: think
had thought
would think
should have thought

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation?
options: If I were you, I would not make that mistake.
If I was you, I would not make that mistake.
If I had been you, I would not make that mistake.
If I will be you, I would not make that mistake.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would not make that mistake.

questions.question: Which option correctly completes the sentence with a cleft sentence structure to emphasize the location? 'It was in London that they first met.'
options: It was London that they first met.
It was in London that they first met.
That they first met was in London.
In London that they first met.
questions.answer: It was in London that they first met.

questions.question: Select the correct form to complete the sentence: 'Had he known about the meeting, [he] ... the details.'
options: might not remember
might not have remembered
might not be remembering
might not remember

questions.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates ellipsis, omitting the understood words while maintaining grammatical correctness?
options: She is taller than her sister, but he is shorter than his brother.
She is taller than her sister, but he is shorter than his brother.
She is taller than her sister, but he is shorter than his brother.
She is taller than her sister, but he is shorter than his brother.
questions.answer: She is taller than her sister, but he is shorter than his brother.
